_comment: Source-of-truth routing manifest for pr-decide.py. 12 intents x 6 targets. Every 'script' must exist on disk (enforced by test_pr_decide.py drift check). A null 'script' means the target has no dedicated verb for that intent — the 'notes' field points at the alternative (usually the tree-dump/poll verb). Args use '<placeholder>' form; never executed by the resolver.

ios.notes: idb ui tap; coordinates in LOGICAL POINTS by default (not screenshot pixels) — pass --space pixels|norm to convert. A press --duration (default 0.1s) is applied so the tap actuates Flutter gesture recognizers; a 0-duration tap silently no-ops on Flutter views.

adb.notes: adb shell input tap; device px. If the screen is locked the event is invisible — send KEYCODE_WAKEUP first.

macos.notes: owner is POSITIONAL (click.py Code 100 200). Flags: --abs --double --triple --right --hold <ms>. Element-by-id via ax_click.py needs no coords.

flutter.fallback: rc=2 on macos/web -> flutter_semantics.py enable, then web_dom.py --selector flt-semantics + web_click.py (web) OR ax_tree.py + click.py (macos). The rc=2 JSON carries a ready 'fallback_commands' array.
flutter.notes: HONEST-GAP on --target macos|web: the Flutter inspector RPC exposes size but NOT transform-to-root, so absolute tap coords can't be synthesised. ios|adb dispatch the physical tap (rc=0; rc=3 if the inner tap subprocess fails). Locate by --key, --type, or --text.

ios.fallback: flutter_set_text.py --target ios (for a FLUTTER text field)
ios.notes: idb ui text. For a FLUTTER field use flutter_set_text instead — ios_type injects into the IME and does NOT fire Flutter onChanged (a form validity gate then never enables).

adb.fallback: flutter_set_text.py --target adb (for a FLUTTER text field)
adb.notes: adb shell input text — ASCII only; spaces auto-encoded to %s. For a FLUTTER field use flutter_set_text (fires onChanged + formatters + validation).

macos.notes: --paste for Unicode (pasteboard + Cmd-V). Refuses with a clear message if macOS Secure Input is active.

flutter.notes: Canonical Flutter text verb. Routes through EditableTextState.updateEditingValue over the VM eval channel — fires formatters + validation + onChanged (the marionette_flutter technique). Locate by --type (EditableText/TextField/CupertinoTextField/wrapper), --key, or --focused (currently-focused field). --target required when two devices run (avoids caching the wrong VM URL). NOT adb_type/ios_type.

adb.notes: adb exec-out screencap -p (exec-out avoids CRLF corruption).

macos.notes: ScreenCaptureKit preferred (lazy import), falls back to the screencapture CLI. Flags: --full --all-displays --cursor --no-shadow --out. TCC preflight (rc=3 if Screen Recording denied).

flutter.fallback: device simctl/adb (ios/adb) OR shot.py <owner> (macos) OR web_shot.py --full (web)
flutter.notes: VM capture = the Flutter scene only (no platform chrome). --allow-device-fallback adds chrome and tags 'source' in the JSON. rc=2 if VM empty and no fallback applies.

ios.notes: idb ui describe-all — accessibility tree, AX frames in logical points.

adb.notes: uiautomator dump, parsed to JSON; bounds in DEVICE px (no dpr derivation needed). Conflicts with running Accessibility Services.

macos.fallback: flutter_tree.py --kind widget (for a Flutter desktop app)
macos.notes: Quartz accessibility tree. Flags: --pid, --max-depth (default 8). rc=2 if pyobjc is missing.

flutter.notes: --kind widget|widget-full|render|layer|semantics (default widget). NOTE: --kind render returns a TEXT dump, NOT bboxes — for structured screen rects use flutter_skeleton (probe-skeleton/2 schema, reads localToGlobal + size).

safari.notes: selenium page_source/outerHTML. web_a11y is NOT supported on Safari (dies rc=2).

ios.notes: Native iOS has NO JS/Dart eval. Introspect with ios_ui_tree.py instead.

adb.notes: Native Android has NO JS/Dart eval. Introspect with adb_ui_tree.py instead. (For a webview use web_eval.py via adb_cdp.py forward.)

web.notes: CDP Runtime.evaluate. --await sets awaitPromise:true (resolves async). Shares _web_eval transport resolver: --browser/--url/--android/--ios/--cdp-port/--serial.

macos.notes: No JS eval on a native macOS app. Dioxus/Tauri webview -> console.py (needs the debug-probe template). AX text -> ax_text.py.

flutter.notes: Dart expression evaluated against the root library over the VM service. Flutter type symbols (WidgetsBinding, Element, RenderBox, EditableTextState) resolve; private cross-library fields (_viewModel) do NOT.

safari.notes: GOTCHA: --await is ACCEPTED but SYNCHRONOUS on WebDriver (no awaitPromise) — a promise-returning expression will NOT be awaited. Requires --url (a fresh WebDriver session starts blank).

ios.notes: No dedicated find verb. Element rects come from ios_ui_tree.py (idb AX frames = logical-point bboxes). For a Flutter widget use flutter_find.py --target ios.

adb.notes: No dedicated find verb. Element rects come from adb_ui_tree.py (uiautomator bounds, device px). For a Flutter widget use flutter_find.py --target adb.

web.notes: No dedicated find verb. Use web_dom.py --selector '<sel>' (outerHTML) + web_eval.py "document.querySelector('<sel>').getBoundingClientRect()" for the rect.

macos.notes: find_window is WINDOW-level only (--all lists multiples, --index N picks one). For ELEMENT rects, ax_tree.py nodes carry position+size; ax_click.py/ax_text.py look elements up by --id/--label.

flutter.fallback: flutter_inspect.py (filtered subtree + rects + optional --golden) / flutter_skeleton.py (every RenderBox rect)
flutter.notes: Locate by --key, --type, or --text (>=1 required). Returns DiagnosticsNode matches {count, matches[]} — NOT screen rects. For actual screen rects use flutter_inspect or flutter_skeleton (localToGlobal + size).

safari.notes: No dedicated find verb. web_dom.py --browser safari --selector '<sel>' + web_eval.py getBoundingClientRect.

adb.notes: adb shell input swipe. --duration-ms (default 300). If the screen is locked the swipe is invisible — send KEYCODE_WAKEUP first.

web.notes: --selector scrollIntoViews the element; --by DX,DY scrolls the viewport. --browser chrome|safari|auto.

macos.notes: Quartz CGEventCreateScrollWheelEvent. --at X Y sets the pointer; --abs for absolute coords.

flutter.notes: No dedicated scroll verb. For certified scroll-scrubbed animation use flutter_anim; for a one-shot scroll use flutter_eval with a scroll expression.

ios.notes: xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo. --start/--stop for background mode (pid file).

adb.notes: adb shell screenrecord + pull. No audio; <=180s per clip.

web.notes: CDP Page.startScreencast -> mjpeg -> ffmpeg mp4. --scroll (Chrome-only page sweep) dies if no ffmpeg / 0 frames.

macos.notes: ScreenCaptureKit/screencapture + ffmpeg. Flags: --start/--stop (background, pid file) --full --clicks --audio --cursor --ffmpeg --out. TCC preflight (rc=3).

flutter.notes: No dedicated record verb. flutter_flipbook records via simctl/adb screenrecord AND recovers the motion law. For a plain video use the device ios_record/adb_record.

safari.notes: macOS screencapture of the Safari window (--scroll not supported).

ios.notes: No native scroll-scrubbed anim cert. ios_flipbook.py recovers TIME/EVENT motion (menu open, entrance) from a recording.

adb.notes: Emulator Chrome/WebView over adb-forwarded CDP (suppresses the Origin header that on-device Chrome 403-rejects).

web.notes: Certifies prop=f(scrollY). Flags: --range lo:hi --steps 40 --settle 1500 --tol 2.0 --detect-only. ALWAYS pair with web_eval first (element anchors + smooth-scroll config + computed transition/animation). --browser/--url/--android/--ios transport flags.

macos.notes: No native anim cert. For a Dioxus/Tauri webview use web_anim.py over the webview CDP transport.

flutter.notes: Certifies prop=f(scrollY) via ScrollableState.position.jumpTo + RenderObject.getTransformTo(null) over the VM service. Flags: --key/--text/--range lo:hi --steps 24 --settle 600. --self-test verifies the core offline. Verified end-to-end against Flutter 3.44 macOS.

safari.notes: WebDriver transport. --ios --url <url> drives Mobile Safari on a booted sim.

ios.notes: simctl boot. ios_boot flags: --shutdown --erase --booted. Then ios_app.py launch <bundle_id> [-- arg...].

adb.notes: adb_boot.py boot <avd> [--wipe]. rc=1 if the emulator exits within 3s (surfaces FATAL log lines); warns on arm32 AVDs on arm64 hosts (use arm64-v8a). Then adb_app.py launch <pkg[/.Activity]>.

web.notes: web_launch.py [--url <url>] starts Chrome with --remote-debugging-port. Then web_open.py <url>. --browser chrome|safari.

macos.notes: macOS apps launch natively (open -a <App>). No boot verb — use focus.py / reposition.py once running.

flutter.notes: Flutter apps MUST be launched EXTERNALLY via `flutter run --debug --disable-service-auth-codes` (cold-launch via flutter build + simctl/adb produces an app with NO VM service). Then flutter_attach.py caches the VM URL (--tail <log> / --auto --source ios|adb|host). Capture the URL ONCE per launch; hot-restart changes the port.

adb.notes: am force-stop <pkg>. adb_boot.py kill runs `adb emu kill`.

web.notes: No dedicated verb. Close a tab via CDP Target.closeTarget, or pkill 'Google Chrome'.

macos.notes: No dedicated verb. osascript -e 'quit app "<App>"' / pkill / window_state.py.

flutter.notes: No Flutter quit verb. Terminate via the host: ios_app.py terminate <bundle_id> / adb_app.py force-stop <pkg>.

safari.notes: No dedicated verb. handle.quit() runs inside the web_* verbs at session end; or pkill safaridriver.

ios.notes: No native wait verb. Poll ios_ui_tree.py. For a Flutter app use flutter_inspect.py --golden (pixdiff SSIM wait).

adb.notes: No native wait verb. Poll adb_ui_tree.py.

web.notes: No native wait verb. Poll web_eval.py (document.querySelector) / web_dom.py.

macos.fallback: wait_pixel.py <owner> --rect x,y,w,h (wait for a region to change)
macos.notes: wait_window.py: --state appear|disappear --timeout 30 --interval 0.25. wait_pixel.py: --rect x,y,w,h --timeout 10 --threshold <bytes>. rc=124 on timeout (the GNU timeout deadline convention).

flutter.notes: No native wait verb. Poll flutter_find.py / flutter_eval.py. flutter_inspect.py --golden does a pixdiff-SSIM wait.

safari.notes: No native wait verb. Poll web_eval.py --browser safari.
